text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And they cross the finish line!!
A new Dirt Emperor of the first half of the year has been decided~!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing race……!
Nobody knew who'd win until the very end……!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Both Hokko Tarumae and Wonder Acute were so close!
The dirt division right now is just amazing with everyone shining so bright!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
“—That was close, Tarumae.
But this has made me certain.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The key to my future is Tarumae...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
If I challenge them, when would it be...?
The gap is still too big... The JBC Classic...?
No, even further ahead—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. Let's set our sights on "that."
If we set it as our goal ahead of time,
I'm sure we'll make it in time...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae...! Acute-san...!
I'll definitely make it there, so just wait for me...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ngh—
Uuuuugggh...!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I didn't reach them...!!
I was so close, too...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Was Hokko Tarumae always the type to get this frustrated...?
It's kind of surprising.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Still, somehow...
She gives off a different vibe than usual, and it's kinda cool—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: —Tarumae-chan.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Acute-san...—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...Dirt racing is so exciting these days, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Every single one of them is blazing, shining, burning hot...—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And the same goes for Tarumae-chan, too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...The 'JBC Classic.'
That's where I'm planning to race next.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I'll be the one taking the victory there.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...I won't let you get away with that, Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll be the one to win!
Let's run together again at the JBC Classic!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...I got carried away and promised that,
but I'm really running the JBC Classic next, right!?
choice_data_list: It's okay, I do intend to run

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Whew... Thank goodness.
The "historic record" meant to be presented to Smart Falcon in order to draw her out—

In aiming for 'Most GⅠ Wins in History,' which was one of them,
the JBC Classic was also a race
where she wanted to deliver results.
Wonder Acute will surely show up there in even better shape than today. For us to win, further training is an absolute must.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I was frustrated that I lost today,
but something happy happened too.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san told me straight to my face
that she's waiting for a rematch...—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That Acute-san actually
considers me her rival—
...To Hokko Tarumae, Wonder Acute had always been a great senior leading the way.

I used to be overwhelmed by her running, but now I can stand shoulder to shoulder and compete with her.
That fact fills me with pride—

Setting her sights on the JBC Classic
as her next battle, she springs into action...!
